title: deck page types
description: The page-type vocabulary. Every name from the design kit's page_types is listed, so a storyboard written against the kit parses rather than failing with 'unknown page type'. Only `implemented` names render; `unimplemented` names are rejected BY NAME with the reason, because silently falling back to a different layout would ship a page the PO never asked for.

unimplemented.description: Names kept in the vocabulary from 02_デザイン仕様.yaml, plus the kit's generic `standard` which standard-3col supersedes. Each carries the reason it is refused.
